name: msdoc_read_word
description:
Reads a Word document (.docx) into its paragraphs and tables. Files are looked up by name in the docs folder (data/msdocs; msdoc_list_files shows it). Needs the python-docx package (optional in requirements.txt).
Returns {filename, paragraphs, paragraph_count, tables, table_count}: paragraphs are the non-empty paragraph texts; each table is a list of rows of cell texts.
Inputs (* required): filename* (e.g. report.docx). Legacy .doc files cannot be read.
To find text use msdoc_search_word; for one plain-text string msdoc_extract_text; for author and dates msdoc_get_word_metadata.
Example: {"filename": "report.docx"}

filename.description: Name of the Word file to read (.docx)
